question: In a certain code language, 'FUTILE' is written as 'UFITEL'. How will 'OCTAVE' be written in that language?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

'FUTILE' is written as 'UFITEL'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c017f59f70cbb4ea03c3c9071086475c28b47ccb96f4f7bdda754717fba68565.png] 

 

Similarly,

'**OCTAVE**' = ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/476be438d2a264ee03c22819111fb0d8b4bedf6547f296be4526a6947a1aeb4a.png] 

Hence, 'OCTAVE' is coded as "**COATEV**".
